title: General definitions, reciprocal pairings and the sign engine

board_content.text: Six functions for any radius r
Since $r>0$ always, the sign of each function is fixed entirely by the quadrant \u2014 the signs of $x$ and $y$.
Pairing rule: cosec goes with sine, sec goes with cosine. Read the third letter.
Q I: all positive. Q II: sin and csc. Q III: tan and cot. Q IV: cos and sec.

board_content.caption: ASTC: which functions are positive in each quadrant

board_content.text: Reciprocals always share their parent's sign.

segments_english.text: Let's write the definitions for a point at any distance, not just radius one.
Take a point x, y on the terminal side, at distance r from the origin. Then sine is y over r, cosine is x over r, tangent is y over x.
Their reciprocals: cosecant is r over y, secant is r over x, cotangent is x over y.

Now the key observation. r is always positive, so it can never change a sign. The sign of every function is decided purely by the signs of x and y, that is, by the quadrant. That is the whole sign engine.
One pairing to fix now, because it trips people: cosecant pairs with sine, and secant pairs with cosine, despite the co in the name. Read the third letter. Co-sec-ant, the third letter matches sine.
The signs are captured by the classic mnemonic, All Silver Tea Cups.
In Quadrant one, all are positive. In two, sine and its reciprocal cosec. In three, tangent and cot. In four, cosine and sec.
Here it is on the circle, going anticlockwise, A, S, T, C.
<whisper>And remember,</whisper> a reciprocal always carries the same sign as its parent, so cosec follows sine, sec follows cosine.

segments_hinglish.text: अब definitions लिखते हैं किसी भी distance वाले point के लिए, सिर्फ़ radius one नहीं.
Terminal side पर point x, y लीजिए, origin से distance r पर. तो sine है y over r, cosine है x over r, tangent है y over x.
इनके reciprocals: cosecant r over y, secant r over x, cotangent x over y.
अब key बात. r हमेशा positive है, so वो sign कभी बदल नहीं सकता. हर function का sign सिर्फ़ x और y के signs से तय होता है, यानी quadrant से. यही पूरा sign engine है.

एक pairing अभी fix कीजिए, क्योंकि यहाँ लोग फँसते हैं: cosecant pairs with sine, और secant pairs with cosine, नाम में co होने के बावजूद. तीसरा letter पढ़िए. Co-sec-ant, तीसरा letter sine से match करता है.
Signs को classic mnemonic पकड़ता है, All Silver Tea Cups.
Quadrant one में सब positive. Two में sine और उसका reciprocal cosec. Three में tangent और cot. Four में cosine और sec.
ये रहा circle पर, anticlockwise, A, S, T, C.
<whisper>और याद रखिए,</whisper> reciprocal हमेशा अपने parent का sign रखता है, so cosec sine को follow करता है, sec cosine को.
